::: {.lede}
I study how consumers engage with brands and with each other in digital media,
combining consumer behaviour, marketing psychology and quantitative methods.
:::

My research focuses on social media brand communication and consumer engagement,
consumer-based brand equity, and digital consumer behaviour, including problematic
gaming and other behavioural risks online. Most of my work uses survey-based
structural equation modelling.

I am a profesor uczelni in the Department of Marketing (Katedra Marketingu),
Faculty of Management and Economics, Gdańsk University of Technology, where I teach
marketing courses in English at Bachelor's and Master's levels.
